I considered buying a railroad from p3 to lower rent, but it would still cost too much and they would keep three. p2 already owns both utilities, so his remaining monopolies require trading with p3 for States or Illinois.

I will end my turn. I will not build, unmortgage, or trade away assets. I will preserve the full $639 cash buffer. North Carolina is unowned and could block green if I land there.
